data: Week-one essentials for new engineers joining Squad Atlas, the team that owns Meridian's money-movement core.
Which tool does Squad Atlas use to run its on-call rotation and page the primary engineer?
Atlas runs its on-call rotation through Opsgenie; keep the app installed on your phone before your first shift (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
What is the acknowledgement SLA for the Atlas primary on-call before an alert escalates?
Alerts route to the primary with a 10-minute ack SLA; miss it and Opsgenie escalates to the secondary, then to the squad lead (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
A scheduled payment settlement fails. What incident severity does Atlas assign it?

Severity is set by impact to money movement, not alert volume. A failed settlement impacts money movement, so it is always Sev1 — never downgraded to Sev2 because 'only a few payments' failed (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
Because Atlas handles cardholder data directly, which compliance regime does the squad operate under?

Atlas operates under PCI-DSS Level 1 — the strictest tier — as Meridian's highest-volume card processor; every engineer completes PCI awareness training before production access (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
How is card data classified in Atlas's data-handling policy?

Card data is classified Tier 0 (Restricted), Meridian's highest data tier: it may never be logged, never appear in error messages, and never leave the boundary of services in PCI scope (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
How does Atlas store the Primary Account Number (PAN) in its datastores?
Encrypted at rest with a rotating key
Tokenized at rest — only the token is persisted

The PAN is tokenized at rest: the tokenization service exchanges it for a token at the edge, and only the token flows through Rail into Atlas storage. A raw PAN found in a log, column, or trace is a Tier 0 incident — page on-call immediately (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
When does Atlas's deploy pipeline refuse normal production releases?
Only during the monthly audit window

The pipeline is gated to refuse production releases Friday through Sunday — no Friday or weekend deploys. A fix that genuinely can't wait goes through the incident-change path with on-call lead plus Priya sign-off (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
Which check must pass before any Atlas pull request can merge?

The ledger-reconciliation contract test must be green before merge — it verifies that recorded entries match settled balances. A red result blocks merge with no exceptions and no override (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
What is Atlas's primary datastore for the ledger?
The primary datastore is Aurora PostgreSQL, chosen for strong consistency on balance reads and the durability money movement demands (Squad Atlas — Architecture & Datastores).
How does atlas-ledger-svc apply a correction to a previously recorded ledger entry?
Updates the existing row in place
Soft-deletes the row and re-inserts it
Appends a new entry that offsets the prior one
Edits the row and writes an audit log line

The ledger is append-only: rows are never updated or deleted in place. Corrections are new entries that offset prior ones, so the full history is reconstructable from the table — which is what makes reconciliation and audit possible (Squad Atlas — Architecture & Datastores).
What is the name of Atlas's primary service and repository, where the ledger and settlement workers live?

atlas-ledger-svc is the primary service and repo housing the ledger, settlement workers, and reconciliation logic — new hires should clone it first (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership / Architecture & Datastores).
What is the internal codename for Atlas's payment-initiation API?

Rail is the internal name for the payment-initiation API exposed by atlas-ledger-svc. 'Submit it to Rail' means the entry point that accepts a payment instruction and hands it to the ledger (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership / Architecture & Datastores).
Who is the squad lead and engineering manager for Squad Atlas?

Priya Nair is the squad lead and EM, and the escalation point for ownership disputes, hiring, and cross-squad commitments touching the payment path. New hires should book a week-one 1:1 with her (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership).
Where does Atlas store its secrets (database passwords, partner-rail keys, tokenization tokens)?
AWS Secrets Manager, tagged by service
Vault, under the per-squad namespace atlas/

All Atlas secrets live in Vault under the dedicated per-squad namespace atlas/. Nothing belonging to Atlas is stored outside that namespace, and secrets are read at runtime — never copied into code, a checked-in .env, a ticket, or chat (Squad Atlas — Secrets & Access).
What customer-facing SLA does Atlas publish for payment-status availability?

Atlas publishes a customer-facing SLA of 99.95% monthly for payment-status availability — customers must be able to see a payment's state (pending, settled, failed) within that target every calendar month, and a breach triggers a customer comms review (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership).
